a.xlink:title: DRT:Trips: A passenger journey of the DRT service: the trip of one passenger from a pickup stop to a drop-off stop during a ride.…
GTFS:Stops: A stop or a station where vehicles pick up or drop off riders. Stops of the regular network and DRT stops are both…
DRT:Arrives_at: Links a DRT trip to the stop where the passenger is dropped off.
DRT:Departs_from: Links a DRT trip to the stop where the passenger is picked up.
DRT:Ride: A vehicle run of the DRT service. A ride is operated by one driver with one shuttle on a DRT line, and includes the…
DRT:belongsToRide: Links a DRT trip to the ride during which it is performed.
DRT:Driver: A person who drives the vehicle during a ride or, for an autonomous shuttle, supervises it.
DRT:driven_by: Links a DRT trip to the driver of the vehicle that performs it.
GTFS:Routes: A public transit line: a group of trips shown to riders as a single service.
DRT:operate_on: Links a DRT trip to the DRT line (route) on which it operates.
Infrastructure:Streets: A street used by vehicles and pedestrians, made of one or more road segments.
DRT:is_located_on_Streets: Links a stop to the street on which it is located.
DRT:Reservation: A booking for the on-demand transport service, made by a customer for one or more passengers. It states the requested…
DRT:hasDropoffLocation: Links a reservation to the requested drop-off stop.
DRT:hasPickupLocation: Links a reservation to the requested pickup stop.
DRT:assigned_to: Links a reservation to the ride (vehicle run) to which it is assigned.
DRT:Customer: A person who books DRT trips. The customer makes the reservation and may travel or book for other passengers.
DRT:madeBy: Links a reservation to the customer who made it.
GTFS:FareProduct: A fare product that riders can buy, such as a single ticket or a pass.
DRT:usesFareProduct: Links a reservation to the fare product applied to it.
GTFS:BookingRule: The booking rules of a service that must be booked in advance, such as on-demand transport: how, when and how far ahead…
DRT:complies_with: Links a reservation to a booking rule that it must comply with, for example a minimum…
time:Interval: A temporal entity with an extent or duration
DRT:hasDropoffTimeWindow: Links a reservation to the time interval in which the passenger must be dropped off.
DRT:hasPickupTimeWindow: Links a reservation to the time interval in which the passenger must be picked up.

DRT:Passenger: A person who travels on a DRT trip under a reservation.
DRT:hasPassenger: Links a reservation to a passenger who travels under it.
GTFS:FareMedia: A medium that holds or validates a fare product, such as a smart card, a paper ticket or a mobile app.
DRT:paidWithMedia: Links a reservation to the fare medium used to pay for it.
DRT:Person: A person involved in the DRT service: a customer, a passenger, a driver or an administrator.
DRT:wasCancelledBy: Links a cancelled reservation to the person who cancelled it: the customer, the driver or…
DRT:includesTrip: Links a ride to a passenger trip that it includes.
DRT:operatedBy: Links a ride to the driver who operates it.
DRT:operatesOn: Links a ride to the DRT line (route) on which it operates.
Infrastructure:DRT_Shuttle: A vehicle temporarily assigned to the demand-responsive transport (DRT) service. It can stop playing this role without…
DRT:usesVehicle: Links a ride to the DRT shuttle that performs it.
DRT:Makes_a: Links a customer to a reservation that he or she makes.
DRT:buy: Links a customer to a fare product that he or she buys.
DRT:Use_fare_media: Links a customer to a fare medium (card, ticket or app) that he or she uses.
DRT:has_Vehicle: Links a DRT line (route) to a shuttle assigned to it.
DRT:make_a_trip: Links a DRT shuttle to a trip that it performs.
DRT:StopAt: Links a DRT shuttle to a stop that it serves.
DRT:wait_at: Links a passenger to the stop where he or she waits to be picked up.
DRT:Travels_by: Links a passenger to the DRT shuttle in which he or she travels.
